title: Twilio Account auth token: must be flagged
summary: Synthetic Twilio Account auth token values built to the documented format appear in 3 inputs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Twilio documents the Auth Token's functional role but no character-class grammar. The bare 32-character lowercase-hex shape, gated on a same-line Account SID or the word "twilio", is corroborated by TruffleHog's twilio detector; no pinned gitleaks rule covers this bare value.

sources.supports: Cited by the legacy assessment (open-source scanner rule); claim not itemised.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Imported as a draft from the legacy suite "Detector coverage" (detector-coverage); not yet reviewed.
